# docker_registry_image_manifests (Data Source)

Reads the per-platform manifests of a multi-platform image straight from its registry, with the provider's `registry_auth`. For a manifest list or OCI index every entry is listed (attestation manifests appear with platform `unknown`); a single-platform image gives one entry whose platform comes from its config blob. Nothing is pulled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_registry_image_manifests" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"
}

# Pin the arm64 variant of a multi-platform tag.
locals {
  arm64 = one([for m in data.docker_registry_image_manifests.nginx.manifests : m.digest if m.os == "linux" && m.architecture == "arm64"])
}

output "nginx_arm64" {
  value = "nginx@${local.arm64}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image reference, e.g. `nginx:1.27` or `ghcr.io/org/app@sha256:...` (no tag means `latest`).

### Optional

- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification of the registry.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the top-level manifest (index, list or image manifest).
- `manifests` (Attributes List) Image manifests, in registry order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manifests))
- `media_type` (String) Media type of the top-level manifest.

<a id="nestedatt--manifests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manifests`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture, e.g. `amd64` or `arm64`.
- `digest` (String) Manifest digest; pin a platform with `<repo>@<digest>`.
- `media_type` (String) Manifest media type.
- `os` (String) Operating system, e.g. `linux`.
- `os_version` (String) OS version (Windows images); empty when none.
- `size` (Number) Manifest size in bytes.
- `variant` (String) CPU variant, e.g. `v8`; empty when none.
